resources.string: Flows are provided via a Fragment or DialogFragment. By default, any nested navigation intents will continue in the same fragment. If a full screen experience is desired for any further navigation intents, toggle the Launch Fullscreen Entry Points switch below.

Components are provided via a Via and are designed to be embedded in experiences unique to the host. Each component requires a callback to launch Lucra Flows from a new fragment. From there, the Flow operates as normal.
Headless interactions do not involve any UI. These functions are intended to be used programmatically, to drive logic behind the scenes
These theming fields can be configured to theme the app to your branding. This will be reset on app restart!
Every flow, headless API and embedded component the SDK exposes. Search, or open a section.
